newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tateho, Daido Hoxan to hold joint briefing.
newsitem.headline: Tateho, Daido Hoxan to hold joint briefing.

text.p: Tateho Chemical Industries Co Ltd and Daido Hoxan Inc said on Friday they would hold a joint news conference at 3.30 p.m. (0630 GMT) at the Osaka Securities Exchange.
They said the briefing would be about media reports, but did not refer to any particular report.
Japanese business daily Nihon Keizai Shimbun reported earlier on Friday that Daido Hoxan was considering taking over troubled Tateho.
Daido said it would also hold a news conference at the Tokyo Stock Exchange on media reports, which it did not specify, at 3.30 p.m. (0630 GMT).
Tateho said on Monday that on a group basis the company's liabilities appeared to have exceeded its assets by about 1.4 billion yen in the financial year that ended on March 31.
Trading of Daido Hoxan's shares and convertible bonds was suspended on Friday on the TSE, while trading in Tateho shares was suspended on the Osaka bourse.
